blocks.content: Imagine playing a game of Treasure Hunt, where you follow a trail of clues connecting one piece of information to the next until you finally reach the treasure.
A linked list is analogous to this trail of connected clues. And each clue (node) has

items: a hint to find the next clue (address of the next node)
